description:
Automate the header of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document to use dynamic metadata fields. 

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/SOP_805_Sterilization.odt'.
2. Go to File > Properties.
3. In the 'Description' tab, set the Title to 'Steam Sterilization Protocol'.
4. In the 'Custom Properties' tab, add two new text properties:
   - Name: 'DocNumber', Value: 'SOP-805-V2'
   - Name: 'Revision', Value: '2.0'
5. Edit the document header to replace the static text with dynamic fields:
   - Replace 'Steam Sterilization Protocol' with the Title field (Insert > Field > Title).
   - Replace 'SOP-805' with the 'DocNumber' custom field.
   - Replace '1.0' with the 'Revision' custom field.
6. The final header must look like: 'Title: Steam Sterilization Protocol | Doc #: SOP-805-V2 | Rev: 2.0'.
7. Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/SOP_805_Automated.odt'.
